name: Workspace Cleaner
author: Omarchy-rs
description: Review and safely remove validated Rust and Node build artifacts with the omarchy-rs cleaner.

barWidget.description: Scan ~/Work for validated, regenerable Rust and Node build artifacts and clean only an explicitly confirmed plan.

schema.label: Workspace root
